response: For admission to the B.E program, a candidate must have passed Pre-University Board or any other examination recognized by the University, with a minimum of 45% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. For students belonging to SC, ST and OBC categories, the minimum is 40%.

response: For admission to the MBA programme, a candidate must have passed a Bachelor's Degree examination or equivalent from a recognized University of a minimum of 3 years duration, and obtained an aggregate minimum of 50% marks taken together in all subjects including languages. For SC, ST and Category-I Karnataka candidates, the minimum is 45%.

response: For admission to MCA, a candidate must have passed BCA or Bachelor Degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent, or B.Sc / B.Com / B.A preferably with Mathematics, and obtained an aggregate minimum of 50% marks. Students without a Mathematics background will have to study and pass bridge courses as notified by the University. For SC, ST and Category-I Karnataka candidates, the minimum is 45%.

what all certificates are required
response: For B.E admission, the required documents are: original Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC), original Pre-University Certificate (PUC), photocopy of Aadhaar Card, original Transfer Certificate and Conduct Certificate, passport size photograph, and migration certificate for non-Karnataka students. For PG programs, original undergraduate degree marks cards and provisional course clearance certificate are also required.
